# ToNumber

Reads a number from text written as a JSON number.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
ToNumber(text)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to read: a string only. White space at either end, as JSON defines it (space, tab, line feed and carriage return), is ignored. Any other type, null included, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Any. The number the text writes, or null when the text is not a JSON number, for example "1,234", "+5", ".5", "01", "Infinity" or the empty string, and when it writes a number too large to represent, such as "1e400".

## Example

`ToNumber(" 12.5 ")` returns 12.5.

`ToNumber("abc") ?? 0` returns 0.
